BoardMemberOut.description:
A board member as the board space names them, the lead of an event.

An account created without a name, such as with createsuperuser, is named
after its email address.

DocumentCountsOut.description:
How many documents answer a search, in all and by category, whatever
the category shown: the chips of the list.

DocumentEventOut.description: The event a document belongs to.
DocumentEventOut.title: DocumentEventOut

What belongs to one kind of document, whole, every key required: the
service keeps the keys of the document's category.

DocumentFilters.description: The documents a search keeps: every filter given applies.
DocumentFilters.title: DocumentFilters

DocumentIn.description:
A document as a member corrects it: whole, every key required.

Its values are checked by the model, whose messages are in French.

DocumentOut.description: A document of the board, as its detail panel shows it.

How the member who deposits a file classifies it: without the assistant
(phase 9), the board classifies by hand.
DocumentUploadIn.title: DocumentUploadIn

EventDashboardOut.description: What an event's page shows of its tabs: their counts, and its tasks block.
EventDashboardOut.title: EventDashboardOut

EventIn.description:
An event as the board writes it: whole, every key required.

A key left out never erases a value, the programme above all. The lists are
given in display order and replace the previous ones. The values themselves
are checked by the model, whose messages are in French.
EventIn.title: EventIn

EventOut.description: An event with all its content, in display order.
EventOut.title: EventOut

ExtractedTaskIn.description: A task the minutes of a meeting list, to create when they are validated.

LatestNoteOut.description: A note of the board, as the dashboard lists the latest.

NoteIn.description: A note as a member writes it. Its values are checked by the model.
NoteIn.title: NoteIn

NoteOut.description: A note of the board, with its replies.
NoteOut.title: NoteOut

NoteUpdateIn.description:
A note or a reply rewritten by its author: a note stays on its event.

A reply keeps no tag and no pin: it is sent with neither.
NoteUpdateIn.title: NoteUpdateIn

OverviewEventOut.description:
An event of the dashboard's table: a row of the board's list, with how
far its tasks have gone and how many notes it has.

PublicEventOut.title: PublicEventOut

ReplyOut.description: A reply to a note, in the order the replies were written.
ReplyOut.title: ReplyOut

ReservationIn.description: A reservation as the board writes it: whole, every key required.

ReservationOut.title: ReservationOut

ReservationStatsOut.description: The figures of an event's reservations: a bounded aggregate.
ReservationStatsOut.title: ReservationStatsOut

StationBoardOut.description: The stations of an event and their totals: a bounded aggregate.

StationIn.description: A station as the board writes it. Its values are checked by the model.
StationIn.title: StationIn

StationOut.description: A station, the people at it, and whether there are enough of them.
StationOut.title: StationOut

TaskIn.description:
A task as the board writes it: whole, every key required.

A key left out never erases a value. The values themselves are checked by
the model, whose messages are in French.
TaskIn.title: TaskIn

TaskOut.description: A task, with whom it is assigned to and when it was done.
TaskOut.title: TaskOut
